author: UnluckyCrocodile
body:
Hi the one who is seeking for a new member,

My name is tdtd27 and this is why you should recruit me:
Im great at pvp (espescially the bow)
I know how to build good defences
I am a teamplayer, i do not troll and do not keep all the diamonds myself (i give them away, i dont like them, everybody targets u)
My k/d: 3929 kills and 2651 deaths, as result 1.48 KD, but i can do better then 1.48... (just look at my stats) https://avicus.net/tdtd27
I am almost always online at Tuesday 19:00-20:30, Thursday 19:00-20:30, Friday 15:30-16:30, Saturday 9:30-11:30 and Sunday 9:30-11:30.
I am 13 years old (i do watch my language) life in Holland, but can speak English (not too good but not too bad)
And i do have skype.

I would like to be part of your team!
